recap.analyst:
Harbor City beat Montaña CF 2-1. On expected goals it finished 0.54–0.42: the chances were close to even, so the result is about right.

Montaña CF had 56% of the ball. Pass completion HAR 71% (110/155), MON 75% (152/202). Shots 6–4, on target 1–1.

Harbor City started in a 4-2-3-1 (direct), Montaña CF in a 5-4-1 (direct). In-game changes: MON to 3-4-3 at 66' (chasing the game); HAR to 4-4-2 at 79' (protecting the lead).

Turning point, 24': Harbor City broke the deadlock through S. Zarnila. The chance was worth xG 0.06 (about 6 in 100 go in), struck at 105 km/h. Score now HAR 1-0 MON. It proved to be the winner.

By the numbers: V. Shindate completed the most passes (26); R. Belruda hit the top speed (33.4 km/h); P. Hirahara covered the most ground (6.65 km, a 18.8 km per-90 pace); D. Haldahl won the most challenges (13).

Discipline: fouls 8–5, yellows 3–2, reds 2–0, offsides 2–0. Conditions: overcast, 20°C, pitch dry, firm.
recap.fan: A tense, tight night at The Arch, London. S. Zarnila broke the deadlock in the 24th minute. Then an own goal in the 52nd gave Harbor City another. S. Kawadate struck in the 82nd for Montaña CF. And the red card changed everything. Montaña CF pushed for a way back, switching to a 3-4-3 in the 66th minute, but Harbor City held firm. The hero: S. Zarnila, with the goal that mattered. At the final whistle, Harbor City celebrate in front of their fans.
